summary: Show every image in a conversation on the phone: a message's images load when they scroll into view and say their name, type and real size before; an image alone in a transcript turn is its image, not the words `[image · load from owner]`; a delivery's <attachment/> becomes the message's image without its path; an ask's images show on its card. A tap zooms (pinch, Close) and Share saves or opens it elsewhere. An unreachable owner and an expired image say so in words.

replay.detail: The phone reads the same claims and timelines; nothing is replayed or migrated.

schema.detail: No schema change; the phone reads the ask attachments the terminal UI change added.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest inputs are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Against an older daemon an ask has no images and transcript images name no size; the phone says size unknown.

manual.detail: Build and install the iOS app again to get the change (docs/stui-and-ios.md).

recovery.detail: Installing the previous app build restores the previous behaviour.
